There was a long waiting queue, but in the end we got our skates…
You: Are you ready?
Bot: Yes, I’m ready.
You: Wanna hold my hand?
Bot: Usually I would agree to that proposition, but in this situation you are trying to patronise me, so I refuse.
Bot: Skating will be no problem for me.
#bot.Expression.veryhappy
Bot: Look! I can already go this fast!
You: You should-
